next_question.rationale: Reason clusters show most drop-offs at the payments page (customer went back from payments page: 3,520) and Play Store reviews flag payment/refund issues; I expect conversion from "started a booking" to "chose a slot and confirmed" to be materially worse on specific device or channel types (for example web vs mobile app).
